rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behavior that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. SG-3 directly establishes this behavior as the evaluation subject, while H-3 supplies the operational situation and hazardous stopping event. The scope addresses whether braking occurs and whether it is intended, without incorporating sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: Vehicle braking behavior is itself the subject required by the Evaluation Target, rather than merely a mechanism affecting its evaluation.
The straight-ahead urban driving situation at 50 km/h, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead and good weather, is explicitly supported by H-3.
The scope includes braking occurrence and its intended or unintended character, directly addressing SG-3 and the hazardous stopping event.
P does not extend to obstacle-detection latency, controller diagnostics, warnings, redundancy, or other supporting mechanisms.
